gold: Cutaneous pseudolymphoma arising as Wolf's post-herpetic isotopic response
e7_champion: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoma
e7_s3: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoma
e7_s4_rationale: The presence of a dense infiltrate of atypical CD4+ small to medium-sized lymphocytes in the dermis, along with the clinical presentation of persistent erythematous and violaceous plaques and nodules, supports this diagnosis. The history of HSV-2 infection and failure of previous treatments also aligns with this condition.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Mycosis fungoides
e7_s4_rejected.why: While mycosis fungoides is a type of cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, the lack of significant epidermotropism in the initial biopsy and the clinical presentation do not strongly support this diagnosis.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes several types of lymphomas, but the specific findings in this case point more towards Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoma.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
e7_s4_rejected.why: The clinical presentation and biopsy findings do not match the typical necrotic and apoptotic features seen in lymphomatoid papulosis.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Cutaneous pseudolymphoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: The presence of atypical lymphocytes and the clinical course suggest a true lymphoma rather than a pseudolymphoma.

v0_pred: Primary cutaneous CD4+ small/medium-sized pleomorphic T-cell lymphoma
